firstRun.note: Auditor ruling after #654: the first real lb-train run (peace-lm-train.yml input run=lb-first-run, main only, GitHub-hosted runner). The corpus is rebuilt in-run at corpusCommit with lb-hidden-drop-hashes.txt and refused unless all three pins equal corpus below and it is a cleared corpus. Weights, saves and checkpoints stay on the runner; Results gets one metrics-only row. lb_run.py refuses LoRA, replay, init/resume, saves and any flag outside daily.trainArgsAllowed, and requires adamw8bit, easy_to_hard and a patience. Sizing: the M37 ext-train.json model (about 9.7 s/step projected on the runner); the run stops on patience, steps or the deadline trainDeadlineMin after the job start, which leaves reserveMin inside jobTimeoutMin.

dailyRun.note: Auditor ruling (saves bucket ready, 2026-10-31): the daily cycle on GitHub, peace-lb-daily.yml (workflow_dispatch only, main only, GitHub-hosted, its own reviewed environment). One cycle per dispatch on the cleared corpus below (rebuilt in-run at b149d9b, pins checked). Saves live only in the private saves bucket under r2Folder/<chain id>/, add-only (an existing save name is refused; nothing is ever removed or overwritten); the resume save and its manifest sha256 come only from the newest add-only Results row runs/lb-daily/<day>-<run id>.json, and the restored save must hash to it before any resume. No Actions artifacts or cache. LoRA stays refused until a full-model run row has baselineBpb == loraUnlock.baselineBpb (the same-split unigram baseline) and a held-out bpb below it, and even then the cycle has no LoRA path (LB_DAILY_LORA_NOT_WIRED). The train settings must not change within a chain (train.py refuses a resume with another config). Batch 6: --val-split disjoint (early-stop val windows share no token with the 96 export eval windows) is not part of the model config, so the chain resumes; its first resumed day restarts early stopping (best.json from the old overlapping split is not carried over).

chain2Run.note: lb-chain2 v1 (spec peaceai/spec/lb-chain2-v1.md; Auditor #673 conditions): peace-lb-chain2.yml (workflow_dispatch only, main only, GitHub-hosted). A NEW chain on the lb-corpus v2 (corpus = lb-corpus2.json build pins, cleared above): chainId = the run id of its first dispatch, saves under the saves bucket r2Folder/<chainId>/ (add-only), trusted record = the add-only Results rows runs/<resultsDir>/<day>-<run id>.json. The corpus is built in a separate job with no secrets (contents: read) and the training job uses it only after lb_chain2.py pins checks docs, manifest and fingerprint.json against these pins (fail closed). Day 1 warm-starts (train.py --warm-start-from) from warmStart.save, whose manifest sha256 is pinned here, in lb-corpus2.json chain2.warmStart and in the day-3 Results row (pinned by its file sha256), and is verified with saves.verify_save before use; later days resume the chain-2 save. Same model shape as dailyRun (the chain-1 tokenizer is reused, so the days-1-3 held-out split tokenizes identically: a row's heldoutTokens and heldBytes must equal the day-3 row's); heldout_v2 is reported separately (eval_v2.py). The train settings must not change within the chain. v2 (spec section v2; Auditor conditions on run 41686765194): the warm day scores the step-0 model on held-out and needs warmStart.heldoutBpb within step0TolBpb (train.py --warm-start-expect), best is seeded with step 0 (a day that never beats it records improved=false), lr <= warmStart.finalLr with warmup 0 and the save's optimizer state kept; v1 rows are retired (a new v2 chain).
